sections.tag: Why Upgrade to AG Charts Enterprise?
sections.heading: Advanced Features for Data-Intensive Applications
sections.subHeading: Explore large datasets with interactive zoom and pan, build financial charts with annotations, implement custom content menus and synchronise multiple charts.

features.heading: Zoom & Pan
features.detail: Mouse wheel scrolling, click-and-drag selection, and keyboard shortcuts for exploring large datasets.

features.heading: Navigator
features.detail: A mini-chart showing the full dataset, allowing users to see context while zoomed into a specific region.

features.heading: Crosshairs
features.detail: Display crosshair lines that follow the cursor, showing exact axis values at any position.

features.heading: Drawing Tools
features.detail: Add trend lines, horizontal/vertical lines, parallel channels, and arrows directly onto charts.

features.heading: Text Annotations
features.detail: Place text labels, comments, callouts, and notes anywhere on the chart with customisable styling.

features.heading: Interactive Editing
features.detail: Drag to reposition, resize with handles, and use the floating toolbar for quick style adjustments.

features.heading: Initial Load
features.detail: Smooth entrance animations when charts first render, drawing attention to data visualisations.

features.heading: Data Updates
features.detail: Animated transitions when data changes, with sequential remove, update, and add phases.

features.heading: Configurable Duration
features.detail: Control animation speed and easing functions to match your application's feel.

features.heading: Right-Click Actions
features.detail: Built-in context menu with zoom controls, download options, and navigation actions.

features.heading: Custom Menu Items
features.detail: Add custom actions with icons, keyboard shortcuts, and nested submenus.

features.heading: Dynamic Menus
features.detail: Show different menu items based on the clicked element for context-aware interactions.

features.heading: Linked Interactions
features.detail: Synchronize zoom, pan, and crosshairs across multiple charts for coordinated data exploration.

features.heading: Shared Axis Domains
features.detail: Keep axis ranges aligned across charts. Changes in one chart update all synchronized charts.

features.heading: Synced Groups
features.detail: Synchronize charts within the same group to create multiple independent groups on a single page.

sections.heading: Financial Charts with Built-In Annotations
sections.subHeading: Candlestick, OHLC, and range charts with drawing tools, technical overlays, and real-time updates. Use the toolbar to add annotations and interact with the data.

sections.heading: Integrated Charts for AG Grid
sections.subHeadingHtml: AG Charts powers the Integrated Charts feature in AG Grid. Users can create charts directly from grid data with a right-click.

sections.heading: Customisable Map Charts for Geographical Data
sections.subHeading: Visualise geographical areas, overlay routes and connections, and add markers and points of interest.

cards.title: Geographic Areas
cards.description: Visualise data representing geographic areas such as countries, using colours to denote distinct series or the magnitude of the values.

cards.title: Routes & Connections
cards.description: Draw geographic lines, such as roads or flight paths, with the ability to vary width and colour to represent data values.

cards.title: Markers & POIs
cards.description: Add markers for geographic points, with the ability to vary the size to represent data values.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.subHeading: Common questions about AG Charts Enterprise features and licensing

items.question: Can I try AG Charts Enterprise for free?
items.answer: Yes! You can install and test all AG Charts Enterprise features locally for free. A watermark and console message will appear until you add a licence key. You can also [request a trial licence](/trial-licence/) to remove these during your evaluation period.

items.question: What is the difference between Community and Enterprise?
items.answer: [AG Charts Community](./quick-start/) is free and open-source with 7 chart types. [AG Charts Enterprise](/license-pricing/) adds Financial Charts, Maps, Gauges, Zoom, Navigator, Annotations, Crosshairs, and more. Visit the [Pricing](./license-pricing/) page for full details.

items.question: How much does AG Charts Enterprise cost?
items.answer: AG Charts Enterprise costs $499 USD per developer for a perpetual licence. This includes 1 year of support and updates. Visit the [Pricing page](/license-pricing/) for full details.

items.question: What is included in the Enterprise Bundle?
items.answer: The Enterprise Bundle includes both AG Grid Enterprise and AG Charts Enterprise for $1,498 per developer. This is ideal if you need both advanced grid features and charting capabilities.

items.question: What chart types are Enterprise-only?
items.answer: Enterprise chart types include Financial Charts (Candlestick, OHLC), Maps (shapes, markers, lines), Gauges (radial and linear), Treemap, Sunburst, Sankey, Chord, Funnel, Pyramid, Waterfall, Box Plot, and Range charts.

items.question: What interactivity features are Enterprise-only?
items.answer: Enterprise interactivity features include Zoom & Pan, Navigator with mini-chart, Crosshairs, Context Menus, Annotations with drawing tools, and Synchronized Charts.

items.question: Does AG Charts Enterprise have Financial Charts?
items.answer: [Financial Charts](./financial-charts/) provide a pre-configured solution for financial data with built-in annotations, range buttons, and a toolbar for technical analysis. Real-time updates are supported at 60+ FPS.

items.question: What support is included with an Enterprise licence?
items.answer: Enterprise licences include access to our dedicated [support portal](https://ag-grid.zendesk.com/hc/en-us). You'll receive priority support from our engineering team, plus access to all updates and new features during your support period.

items.question: Is the Enterprise licence perpetual?
items.answer: Yes, AG Charts Enterprise licences are perpetual. You can use the version you licensed forever. The annual support and updates subscription is optional for renewal, but recommended to access new features and fixes.

items.question: Can I upgrade from Community to Enterprise?
items.answer: Yes, upgrading is simple. Just install `ag-charts-enterprise` alongside your existing AG Charts packages and add your licence key. All your existing code will continue to work, and Enterprise features become available immediately.
